description: Round-1 A/Bs, only after the gates pass: tiled prefill on the tensor cores (prefill_kernel, long), verification kernel (verify_kernel, chat), KV storage fp16/int8/fp8 (kv_dtype_all, chat + long), and the T4 decode rejections re-measured with 6x the L2 (decode_kernel, decode_split_k). Then a roofline for the record. Each A/B is its own process and is gated against stock Transformers before timing.
